Title: Enter comments card on Home opens the Distributions page
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

Step Action: Look for the Enter comments card under the Results section.
Step Expected: The Enter comments card is visible.

Step Action: Click the Enter comments card.
Step Expected: The browser navigates to the address path /DistributionComments.aspx or /CommentsEntry.aspx.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page that opened.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Distributions.

Step Action: Read the browser tab title.
Step Expected: The title reads Distribution comments - Proficiency Testing and no server error page is shown.

Title: Distributions comments page shows the search labels and buttons
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/DistributionComments.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The page loads with the h1 Distributions and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the labels of the search form.
Step Expected: The labels Distribution Reference, Scheme Name and Scheme Code are shown.

Step Action: Look for the SEARCH button.
Step Expected: The SEARCH button is visible.

Step Action: Look for the SHOW ALL button.
Step Expected: The SHOW ALL button is visible.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown and the h1 is still Distributions.

Title: Searching distribution comments with an unknown reference then SHOW ALL keeps the page working
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/DistributionComments.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The page loads with the h1 Distributions.

Step Action: Type ZZ-NO-SUCH-REF in the Distribution Reference box.
Step Expected: The box shows ZZ-NO-SUCH-REF.

Step Action: Click the SEARCH button.
Step Expected: The page reloads with the h1 Distributions and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Look at the results area below the search form.
Step Expected: No distribution row is listed for ZZ-NO-SUCH-REF.

Step Action: Click the SHOW ALL button.
Step Expected: The page reloads with the h1 Distributions and the search form is still shown.

Step Action: Read the Distribution Reference box.
Step Expected: The Distribution Reference box is cleared or empty.

Title: Distributions comments page keeps its heading after a reload and Back returns to Home
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/Home.aspx as a signed-in external user.
Step Expected: The home page loads with the h1 VETQAS Proficiency Testing.

Step Action: Click the Enter comments card.
Step Expected: The h1 reads Distributions.

Step Action: Reload the page.
Step Expected: The page reloads and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page.
Step Expected: The h1 is still Distributions.

Step Action: Select the browser Back button.
Step Expected: The browser returns to the address path /Home.aspx.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page.
Step Expected: The h1 reads VETQAS Proficiency Testing and no server error page is shown.
